title: Te Mokemoke i raro i te Nikau Tawhiti
intro: Whakaarohia he wāhi okiokinga marino, tawhiti atu i ngā mano tini, te wāhi e tūtaki ai te aroha ki tētahi ture whakamiharo. Ka hoki whakamuri tētahi pononga mokemoke i roto i te parakore me te whakawhirinaki, e tautokona ana e te whakarato kāore e kitea. I te taha o tēnei wairua ka huihui ngā tohu e whakahē ana i ngā whakamārama noa, i te mea e tatari ana ngā hāhā o te ruarua ki tua atu o te wāhi mokemoke. Haere tata mai, whakarongo mai, nā te mea ka werohia e te pono ngā whakaaro katoa.
clues: I whakatapua e ahau ahau ki te karakia i te mokemoke, i tautokona e te kai a tōku Ariki.
I tae mai te rongo pai ki ahau, nā te mea kua whiriwhiria ahau e Allah i runga ake i ngā wāhine katoa o te ao.
I hoki atu ahau ki tētahi wāhi tawhiti ki te rawhiti, i te mea e araia ana e tōku iwi, ka puta mai tētahi wairua ki ahau i roto i te āhua o tētahi tangata tino tika.
Nā te kupu a Allah i hapu ai ahau, ahakoa kāore anō kia pā mai tētahi tangata ki ahau.
I whakamanawanui ahau ko au anake i te mamae i raro i te nikau, ā, ka rongo ahau i tētahi reo e whakamarie ana i ahau me te awa i raro i ahau me ngā tāme hou hei kai, hei inu.
I hoki ahau ki tōku iwi, e waha ana i taku pēpi hou, i oati ahau mō te wahangu, ā, i kōrero mai taku pēpi mai anō i te whanga hei tiaki i ahau hei pononga mā Allah.
